title: UPCI Reports General Conference 2026 Election Results
description: UPCI Communications reports Scott Graham’s reelection as general secretary-treasurer and Jordan Hudspeth’s election as general youth secretary.

sections.heading: General secretary-treasurer
paragraphs: UPCI Communications reports that Scott Graham was reelected general secretary-treasurer of the United Pentecostal Church International during General Conference 2026 in Salt Lake City, Utah.

sections.heading: Youth leadership transition
paragraphs: According to the report, Jordan Hudspeth was elected general youth secretary to succeed Jeremy Stafford.
